dj.append({"input":[[5,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,9,3,5,5,5,5,9,3,5,5,9,5,5],[3]*17,[5,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,9],[5,5,9,5,5,3,9,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,5],[3]*17,[5,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,9,5,5,3,5,5,5,5,5],[9,5,5,5,5,3,9,5,5,5,5,3,5,5,9,9,5]],"output":[[5,5,5],[5,5,5],[5,1,1]]})
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    rr=[r for r in range(H) if r not in sep_rows]; cc=[c for c in range(W) if c not in sep_cols]
    def blocks(idx):
        out=[];cur=[idx[0]]
        for x in idx[1:]:
            if x==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(x)
            else: out.append(cur);cur=[x]
        out.append(cur); return out
    rb,cb=blocks(rr),blocks(cc)
    cells=[g[r][c] for rs in rb for cs in cb for r in rs for c in cs]
    from collections import Counter
    base=Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[[base]*len(cb) for _ in rb]
    for i,rs in enumerate(rb):
        for j,cs in enumerate(cb):
            blk=[g[r][c] for r in rs for c in cs]
            special=sum(1 for v in blk if v!=base)
            res[i][j]=1 if special>=2 else base
    return res
